answer: An farming party thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The ridge schedule is applied in horizon and bridge makes public each instalment. A payout is split and as a result 57% arrives at settlement and the rest over 9 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2439 identities would post 3059 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
